segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Madam Speaker, distinguished colleagues, I rise to sponsor the proposed fiscal year 2027 budget of the Department of Social Welfare and Development.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: The proposed national budget carries the theme, People-Centered Growth for an Inclusive and Resilient Future.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: Under it, P241.2 billion is proposed for the DSWD to support vulnerable families and provide assistance to those in need.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: Behind that figure are people who cannot wait, a child who needs a nutritious meal, a family struggling to keep its children in school,

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: an older person with no steady income, and a household rebuilding after a disaster.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: The DSWD reaches these families at different points in their lives.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: The Pantawid Pamilyang Pilipino Program supports children's health and education.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: Feeding and food assistance address hunger.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: Protective services help people through crisis.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: Social pensions help older Filipinos meet their daily needs.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: These programs are strongest when they work together.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: Emergency assistance helps a family get through today.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: Education, nutrition, and livelihood opportunities can help change what tomorrow holds.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: Madam Speaker, Congress must also ask what this appropriation will achieve.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: Are eligible families receiving help on time?

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: Are we reaching communities that are hardest to serve, including island and remote barangays?

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: Are our programs helping households recover from hardships and build a more secure future?

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: We owe the Filipino people accurate targeting, timely delivery, transparent spending, and results.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: They can feel in their daily lives.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: Secretary Rex Gatchalian reported during the Committee on Appropriations briefing

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: that the Department achieved nearly full utilization of its 2025 funds.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: It also sets a standard for the year ahead.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: Funds must be used effectively and assistance must reach the people for whom Congress provides it.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: will be measured in a child better nourished, a student able to remain in school, a family supported through a crisis, an older person treated with dignity, and a community able to recover after a disaster.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: Our task is to turn public resources into public good. For social welfare, that means being present when the people need government most and helping families move forward, lasting security and opportunity.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: I therefore respectfully sponsor the proposed fiscal year 2027 budget of the Department of Social Welfare and Development and urge this Honorable Chamber to give it its careful consideration.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Sa ano po? Dun po sa deposit?

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Actually, yan po ang pinakamaraming reklamo, yun sa deposit.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Hindi tinatanggap yung mga pasyente hanggang hindi nagdi-deposito. Mamamatay na, kailangan mag-deposito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Parang sa akin pa lang po yata.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, meron po ba tayong

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: like a seal of good governance

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: nagkakaroon tayo ng rating sa kanila

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: pag wala pong silang mga violation

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Thank you for that, distinguished sponsor, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: If a patient is admitted, but

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: medically ready for discharge in less

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So, ang tinatanong ko po dito,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: pero pinalabas ka in less than

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Let me move to my next question.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, quick question lang for

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: and increased coverage for cardiac devices

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: dahil medyo may kamahalan po yung mga

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: devices na ito, pero dun po

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Natanggap na po ng PhilHealth at kasalukuyang po ang pinag-aaralan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Kung sakali po bang magiging medically justified yan, magkano ang kakailanganin na additional funding ng PhilHealth para sa 2027?

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: At this point, Mr. Speaker, Honorable Colleague, wala pang figure kasi kasalukuyang pinag-aaralan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: But PhilHealth can update the Honorable Nassal on this.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: But it is a consideration. We are considering expanding the service.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Yeah, well, pinag-aaralan po, Honorable Colleague.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Thank you for that, Distinguished Sponsor, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: May I move now to Yakap.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, once PhilHealth pays an LGU for its services,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Yakap patients, how do you ensure that money actually improves that health center?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Doctors, medicines, laboratories, diagnostics, and equipment?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Kasi po, di ba currently, parang nagmumawa lang yung mga LGU.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So, ang tinatanong lang po natin is, is there an assurance na pag nabayaran na po sila, dumami yung PhilHealth, yung Yakap patients,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: how will we assure na ito pong mga LGUs will improve on their health centers na ginawa po nilang Yakap Center?

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So, dun po sa mga accredited LGUs na qualified na po or accredited for the Yakap program,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: syempre may computation fund po ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: And, dapat lamang na yung LGU ginagamit ito to improve their facility.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So, the question po, tama po yun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So, the question is, how do we assure that they will improve on the facility?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Is there a change in the contract or the qualification?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Kasi po, di ba, right now, we allow them to become Yakap, to be accredited as a Yakap facility

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Have a MOA with either hospitals or diagnostic clinics.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Tama po yun, yung mga primary health care centers, pwedeng mag-outsource habang wala pa sila na mga facilities na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So, how long will we allow that until we expect improvement from their own facilities?

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Originally, Mr. Speaker, Honorable Colleague, 2027 yung deadline.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Pero, we understand, iba-iba yung kapasidad ng bawat LGU.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Kaya, some may comply and some may lag behind, Mr. Speaker, Honorable Colleague.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, my next question is, Distinguished Sponsor,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: do we monitor whether LGU Yakap facilities are actually issuing gamot prescriptions?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Because kami po, nakikita namin na may patients who cannot access Yakap gamot

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: because the LGU is waiting for its own Yakap gamot accreditation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Is an LGU allowed to delay or withhold a medically indicated prescription for that reason?

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So, opo, the answer is yes, Mr. Speaker, Honorable Colleague, minomonitor po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: And in order to improve the system further, ngayon po, yung mga medicine, ililipat na po dun sa gamot program

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: para to ensure na may constant and reliable supply because these are relationships with the pharmacy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Are we also looking into the possibility of not limiting the prescription coming from Yakap accredited doctors?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: From PhilHealth, including yung PhilHealth universe na po ng mga doctors?

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Currently po, kailangan dun sa accredited health provider.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Hindi siya pwedeng coming from, tapos mag-avail sa mga accredited doctors ng PhilHealth,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: tapos mag-avail na lang sa Yakap.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Pwede pong pag-aralan, pero para may control po tayo sa quality ng service na ibibigay at hindi magka-problema,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Maraming salamat po sa DOH and I fully support the budget for 2027.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: At maraming salamat sa ating kaibigan, si Honorable Robert Nazal.

segments.text: Maraming maraming salamat, Congressman Robert Nazal of VH Partylist.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Congressman Nisay, you have the floor, sir. Please proceed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, sa ating buting sponsor, mga ilang katanungan lamang po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: sa DOH budget briefing po ay na-erase na may 36 out of 82 provinces

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: na walang medical facility managed by DOH.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: kaugnay po nito may panukalang House Bill No. 11349

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: o ang Tertiary Hospital in Every Province Act

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: authored by no less than our Mr. Sponsor himself,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: kasama si na Minority Leader Nonoy Libanan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: na naglalayong magkaroon ng at least one DOH supervised tertiary hospital

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: ay suportado ba o susuportahan po ba ng Department of Health

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: paano makakatulong ang pagkakaroon ng at least one DOH managed tertiary hospital

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: in every province sa pagtugon ng geographic gaps

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: at sa pananaw ng higher level government hospital services?

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Ang sagot po sa inyong katanungan is yes,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: especially dun sa 36 na wala pa pong DOH hospital na nakatalaga

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Mga probinsya po na kasalukuyang walang DOH managed medical facility, mayroon na bang initial assessment ang DOH? Kung alin ang may mga kakayhang matugunan through upgrading or conversion? At alin ang mga mangangailangan talaga ng bagong hospital?

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, yung nabanggit ko po kanina na innovative solution ng ating sekretary with regards to all these gaps, yung hospital cluster na i-create na magmamanage ng mga CHDs in the region hanggang sa local level,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: yun po ang magdedetermine kung ano yung mga strategic options.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: And surgical, if I may say, interventions na gagawin ng DOH para mapunan kaagad yung mga pagkukulang na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Maraming salamat po sa ating buting sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Ang susunod na katanungan ko po ay may kinalaman sa mental health.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Ano po ang mga kongkretong gagawin ng DOH para ma-resolve ba ang mahirap at mabagal na repairal system para sa mental health patients, lalo na sa inyong mga nasa malalayong municipalities at provinces?

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Kunin ko lang po yung listahan para sa sagot ng inyong katanungan, Mr. Speaker, Honorable Minister.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So, ito po, Mr. Speaker, Honorable Nisay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So, number one, governance RA-11036 or mental health law.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Number two, promotion and prevention ng MNS health literacy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Yung peer-to-peer, school and workplace-based mental health services, psychological, first aid, MHPSS, and guidelines on ethical portrayal of suicide.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: MNS screening, risk of substance abuse, drug dependency examinations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Number four naman po, sa treatment, MH access program, community-based mental health, community-based drug rehab program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Number five, sa financing naman po, inpatient and outpatient benefit package, 432 general mental health providers, and 21 specialty mental health providers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Number six naman po, sa workforce, psychologist.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: But only at this time in 12 health facilities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: na 3,401 but only to 246 in health facilities in the country. So yun po yung mga efforts na ginagawa ng DOH with regards to mental health.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Maraming salamat po sa ating buting sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Kung ang pasyente ay nangailangan ng psychiatric consultation, emergency intervention, o admission,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Bakit kailangan pa nilang bumiyahin ng napakalayo o pumunta sa Manila?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: May plano po ba ang DOH na mag-establish o mag-upgrade ng mental health units sa bawat probinsyal hospital, magkaroon ng dedicated patient navigation referral system, at magtalaga ng referral focal person sa bawat province para hindi na pamilya mismo ang naghahanap kung saan dadali ng pasyente?

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So, kasalukuyan ay nagsiset up ang DOH ng mga mental health specialty center unit in every region consistent with the Regional Specialty Center Act.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: At the same time, dahil it would take some time to set this up,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: ay pwede rin pong tumawag ang may mga pangangailangan with regards to mental health.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Maraming salamat sa ating buting sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, sa ating pong buting sponsor,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: naniniwala po tayo na prevention is better than cure.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Sa ngayon po, mas magandang maagapan muna ang mga may sakit bago lumala, bago natin po gamutin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: At ngayon po, makikita natin na

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: medyo tumataas ang non-communicable diseases na kinamamatay ng pamilyang Pilipino.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: ang GAA ng DOH Health Promotion Budget mula 2022 hanggang 2026.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Ang health promotion po noong 2022 na lumabas sa GAA ay P528.7 million plus pesos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Noong 2023, umabot po ng P1.9 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: At noong 2024, medyo buwaba po, naging P1.7 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Noong 2025 naman po, umaba pa rin po, naging P1.4 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: At ngayong 2026, umabot po ng P1.1 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Kung mapapansin po natin, hindi po naabot yung target na 1% allocation pagdating po sa total DOH budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Ang pondo ng health promotion at ano po yung mga barriers kung bakit po pababa siya ng pababa?

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Ang ideal ratio po ng pondo na nilalagay for health promotion is around 1% of the entire budget of DOH.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: medyo malapit-lapit naman po sa 1%, nasa 0.937%.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: At itong mga pondo na ito ay ginagamit sa

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: dinagamit sa health governance, policy, and M&E assessment and research.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Support for health communities, schools, and workplace.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: 468 million sa health literacy, BCS, health campaigns, SBCC, and risk communication.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: 316 million naman po sa health literacy on MERS and media campaign and partnerships.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: At 60 million po sa operational support, mga JO personnel,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor, sa 2027 budget presentation po ng DOH para sa health promotion,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: may targets na 2,830 schools, 178 workplaces, and 45 province-wide, city-wide health systems

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Paano naman po sinusukat ng health promotion bureau?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Kung ang mga programang ito ay talagang nagpapabago ng health behavior

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: at hindi lamang nagpaparami ng activities, trainings, at information campaigns?

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Meron pong ginagawa, Mr. Speaker, Honorable Colleague, na survey

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: para makita kung umaakyat yung awareness

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: At health consciousness ng ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So ito po yung mini-measure kung saan po ginagawad yung pondo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Sa pagpili po ba ng mga target schools at workplaces,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: prioredad po ba ang mga may matataas na prevalence ng obesity, smoking,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: poor nutrition, physical inactivity, o iba pang health risk?

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Meron po tayo, Mr. Speaker, Honorable Colleague, ng seven priority actions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: And number one po dito, nutrition and physical activity at substance use, yung tabako, alcohol, and drugs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: At mayroon din pong priority action on mental health.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, sa ating buting sponsor, kung 2,830 schools lamang po ang target for 2027,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: ano po ang plano ng DOH para ma-expand ang Healthy Lifestyle Initiative

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Lalo't maliit na porsyento po lamang

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: ay mula sa voluntary healthcare payment schemes.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: kung saan nagagamit ang mga pondong ito,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: ay nakatuan po sa curative care at medical goods.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: para ho palakasin ang ating health promotion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: So, hindi ko lang ho alam

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: ng bagong National Health Promotion Board Bill.

segments.text: Siguro ho, narinig na ho natin ito

segments.text: Ito po ay dagdag na manpower,
